meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新版本发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布了新版本后需要确认它真正上线了
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version to npm and confirm the release succeeded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a new version and verify it went live

howto.what: 安装后，当你说发布时，Claude 会充当发布经理：触发 GitHub Actions 发布流程，等待它跑完，验证 npm 包和 GitHub 发布页，起草并应用发布说明，再尝试在 Discord 发公告，最后汇报结果。它不会顺便做代码审查或修代码。
howto.when: 当你说“发布”“部署”“npm publish”等词，并给出 patch、minor、major 或具体版本号（如 5.0.0-beta.9）时触发。没给版本类型时它会停下来问你。

say.note: 触发补丁版本发布流程。
按指定预发布版本号发布。

howto.what_en: When you ask for a release, Claude acts as release manager: triggers the GitHub Actions workflow, waits for completion, verifies npm packages and GitHub release, drafts/applies release notes, attempts a Discord post, then reports. No code review or fixes during publish.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "publish", "release", "deploy", "npm publish", etc., and provide patch, minor, major, or an explicit version like 5.0.0-beta.9. If no version type is given, it stops and asks.
